ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-01..2026-08-01
